result.brief: 提出基于交互阶段文本与视频扩散先验重渲染的单目视频人-物4D重建方法。
result.reason: Main contribution is 4D human-object reconstruction from monocular video via diffusion-based re-rendering; no world-model, representation-learning, or generation-model contribution, and it is reconstruction rather than interactive/physical world modeling.
